# What each said of itself, asked with -I (the same shape on both machines):
#   the installer's 3.10.11: site folders C:\Program Files\Python310 and ...\lib\site-packages; sys.path, in order:
#     C:\Program Files\Python310\python310.zip (not there), ...\DLLs, ...\lib, C:\Program Files\Python310,
#     ...\lib\site-packages; one *.pth file in its site folder, distutils-precedence.pth (one `import` line)
#   the copy: executable and base executable C:\Program Files\RaqibProbe9Py\python.exe; sys.path, in order:
#     ...\python312.zip (not there), ...\DLLs, ...\Lib, C:\Program Files\RaqibProbe9Py, ...\Lib\site-packages;
#     no *.pth file; without -I the path began with '' (the folder it was started in) and the user's site was on
#   the venv: executable C:\Program Files\RaqibProbe9Venv\Scripts\python.exe, base executable the copy's;
#     prefix the venv, base prefix the copy; sys.path, in order: the copy's python312.zip (not there), its DLLs,
#     its Lib, the copy's folder, C:\Program Files\RaqibProbe9Venv, ...\RaqibProbe9Venv\Lib\site-packages;
#     pyvenv.cfg: home = C:\Program Files\RaqibProbe9Py ; include-system-site-packages = false ; version = 3.12.10
# A plain user (made for the run), of the copy and the venv: write beside the interpreter, into its site folder,
#   into the raqib package, to a module of the library, into the venv's site folder, to the venv's pyvenv.cfg, give
#   the copy's folder another name - REFUSED, all seven; run it - DONE.
# The watch as a service from the copy, its command `"C:\Program Files\RaqibProbe9Py\python.exe" -I -m raqib service
#   run`: made, running, a round read, stopped, removed.
